reproducibility_gaps: No repository license or project citation metadata is identified in final Stage-2 authority.

Posting.zip is bundled but remains uninspected under bounded static extraction.
Notebook-specific seeds, device selection and hyperparameters do not establish repository-wide reproducibility.
Scientific execution and external-data loading are outside the static Stage-3 boundary.
